scheme_name: Dr. D.S. Kothari Post Doctoral Fellowships In Sciences
other_conditions: Candidate must hold a doctorate degree in the relevant subject, preferably with published research work
Only Ph.D. awarded unemployed candidates are eligible
Upper age limit is 35 years, with age relaxation for SC, ST, OBC and women candidates as per Government of India norms
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly fellowship of Rs 43,800–46,500 for up to three years, along with annual contingency, HRA and hostel accommodation.
